title: ATTP – BRAND OF THE YEAR 2023!
body_html:
The National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova is especially honoured to have been named Brand of the Year 2023 at a fine event of special scale — the NOTORIUM Awards Gala, which was also an opportunity for the sporting community to meet ingenious, brave and ambitious people who are true personalities in other important areas of society.

We are equally honoured to receive this high distinction, which for us is a challenge to continue what we do even more intensively and productively.

We thank our colleagues at TOP CUP Academy, SETKA-PRO and our development partners for the trust they continuously place in ATTP. They deserve all the appreciation and gratitude for the progress they have made possible for ATTP in this area of sport.

We also sincerely thank the INTELSTART team and, in particular, Tatiana and Marian BUNESCU, who came up with this extraordinary initiative and have kept it going for the 8th year running, and we wish them many more editions of this remarkable and welcome event.
